notes: Paper reports 95%-credible upper limits on kinetic mixing ε from analysis of SuperMAG global magnetometer network data. Limits are placed in the mass range 2×10^-18 eV ≲ m_A' ≲ 7×10^-17 eV (corresponding to frequencies 6×10^-4 Hz ≲ f ≲ 2×10^-2 Hz). The data points represent approximate endpoints of the exclusion band shown in Fig. 4. No robust signal candidates were identified. The search assumes dark photons constitute all of the local dark matter (ρ_dm ≈ 0.3 GeV/cm³). The signal arises from dark-photon dark matter driving oscillating magnetic fields at Earth's surface via kinetic mixing with ordinary photons, using the Earth as a natural transducer with the lower atmosphere acting as a cavity between the conducting Earth and ionosphere/interplanetary medium.
